data.name: HintMute
data.value: Check to mute all sound from the system, not only desktop sounds.

data.name: HintStartup
data.value: Check to play a tune when you log in, log out and lock the screen.

data.name: HintDesktop
data.value: Check to hear sounds when you launch, open, move and remove icons.

data.name: HintWindows
data.value: Check to hear sounds when windows are minimized and restored, and when you change desks.

data.name: HintAlerts
data.value: Check to hear a sound when a dialog asks for your attention.

data.name: HintBell
data.value: Check to turn on the keyboard bell.

data.name: HintOutput
data.value: Choose the speakers or headphones desktop sounds play through.

data.name: HintScheme
data.value: Choose the set of sounds the desktop plays.

data.name: HintClose
data.value: Close this panel. Changes have already been applied.

data.name: HintReset
data.value: Put back the settings this panel opened with.

data.name: HelpText
data.value: Choose which kinds of sound the desktop plays, which set of sounds it plays them from, and where they are heard. Mute System silences everything the computer plays, as the audio panel's mute does. Changes apply as you make them; turning a kind of sound on plays one of its sounds. Reset restores the settings from when this panel opened.

data.name: MuteFailed
data.value: The sound server would not change the mute.

data.name: FileInvalid
data.value: {0} is not valid; showing the last good values.
